name: Health-Aware Recipe Modifier
description: A full-stack web application that helps users modify recipes based on medical conditions by detecting harmful ingredients, suggesting healthy alternatives, and generating personalized recipes using AI.
lessons: Built rule-based ingredient analysis combined with AI generation; gained experience with Flask authentication, MongoDB data modeling, PDF report generation, and health-focused data validation.

name: AI Explains This Repo
description: A developer tool that analyzes public GitHub repositories and explains code quality, security issues, performance bottlenecks, and architecture decisions in plain English using AI.
lessons: Designed AI-powered repository analysis workflows; handled GitHub API limitations, authentication flows, structured AI explanations, and scalable Next.js App Router architecture.

name: VArch (DSL to Diagrams)
description: A browser-based tool that converts a minimal domain-specific language into clean software architecture diagrams, enabling diagram-as-code without drag-and-drop editors.
lessons: Learned to design and parse a custom DSL, convert text into graph structures, and render architecture diagrams dynamically with a clean, developer-friendly UX.
